clue.text: Like classy cutlery Victor needs before slicing fish

indicators.note: the Victor-plus-before pair cuts into the fish, ending up inside it

parts.note: a sild is a young herring, sold canned like a sardine
V is Victor in the radio alphabet
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: A posh dinner service: someone named Victor must lay out the good cutlery before carving the fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs' is only a link. VERE goes inside SILD.
explanation.definitionFit: Good-quality cutlery is often plated with silver, so it is described as coated in that metal.

clue.text: Bad mark repeatedly given in current exam

indicators.note: the doubled mark is placed inside the current-plus-exam string

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current
an oral is a spoken examination

indicators.note: the single letter for mark is taken twice over

parts.note: M stands for the mark, the old German currency

explanation.surface: A student gets poor marks over and over in an oral test given right now.
explanation.walkthrough: M is the old German mark; I is the physics symbol for current.
explanation.definitionFit: Bad in the moral sense: wicked or unethical conduct is described this way.

clue.text: See semi-nude restored — see disarmingly beautiful work!

parts.note: V is short for Latin vide, see, as in cross-references

indicators.note: the letters of semi-nude are put back together in a new order, as a damaged statue might be restored

parts.note: lo is an old exclamation meaning look or see

explanation.surface: Look at this half-naked figure, repaired: it is a beautiful sculpture to behold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restored' turns SEMINUDE into ENUSDEMI. 'disarmingly' is a pun: the famous statue has lost its arms.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek statue of Aphrodite in the Louvre is a celebrated armless sculpture of great beauty.

clue.text: Consult match official here in middle

parts.note: ref is short for referee

indicators.note: only the central letters of the word here are taken

explanation.surface: Ask the referee, who is standing right here in the centre of the pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: To consult a reference book is to turn to it for information, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Sunk in ready under the sea

indicators.note: in this down clue the word for ready sits below the word for the sea

parts.note: the deep is a poetic name for the sea
set means prepared, as in 'ready, steady, go' or 'all set'

explanation.surface: Something sunk and lying ready at the bottom of the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep-set eyes are sunk well into the face, so the hyphenated adjective means recessed.

clue.text: Engineer succeeded separating gold from another metal

indicators.note: the letter for succeeded comes between the two metals, keeping them apart

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
tin is a metal
s is the genealogical abbreviation for succeeded

explanation.surface: A metallurgist manages to part gold from a different metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Herbert Austin was the English motor engineer who founded the Austin car company.

clue.text: Sundial fixed in two areas in Spanish region

indicators.note: the rearranged sundial goes between the two area letters

parts.note: A is short for area, so two areas give two As

indicators.note: the letters of sundial are repaired into a new order

explanation.surface: A sundial repaired and set up in two parts of a region of Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the large autonomous community of southern Spain, home to Seville and Granada.

clue.text: Beginners in studio photographed as well

indicators.note: the opening letters of the three following words are taken

explanation.surface: New models in a studio had their pictures taken too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as well' reads as one phrase meaning too; 'well' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring of mineral water, where people go to drink it for their health, is also called a well.

clue.text: With it, leader gets round large suspicion

parts.note: in means fashionable or with it

indicators.note: the leader's word encircles the letter for large

parts.note: a king is a leader of a country
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A trendy boss who goes round with a big hunch.
explanation.definitionFit: A faint suspicion or hint of an idea is a slight notion of what is going on.

clue.text: Woman's work in male domain — football pitch

parts.note: a man's field is an area belonging to a man
park is slang for a football pitch

explanation.surface: A woman's job done in a male-dominated sphere, the football ground.
explanation.walkthrough: The woman is Jane Austen, and her 'work' is a novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Jane Austen's 1814 novel is a literary work by a woman writer.

clue.text: Roman things are returned in rubber

indicators.note: the combined Latin noun and the verb are read backwards

parts.note: res is the Latin word for things

explanation.surface: Ancient Roman artefacts have been sent back wrapped in rubber.
explanation.walkthrough: RESARE read backwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: In British English a rubber is the stationery item that rubs out pencil marks.

clue.text: Coil's reliable one put back in

definitions.note: read as 'coil is'; the definition is the coil

indicators.note: the reversed word goes inside the word for reliable

parts.note: solid means dependable

indicators.note: the word one is written backwards

explanation.surface: A coil is a trustworthy part to fit back into the machine.
explanation.definitionFit: This electrical component is a cylindrical coil of wire that acts as a magnet when current flows.

clue.text: What could make late run for summit?

parts.note: read as an instruction, the answer says take NE and add ULTRA; those letters rearranged make the words late run

explanation.surface: Which runner could turn a late spurt into reaching the top?
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: the answer, read as 'NE plus ULTRA', names letters that could be rearranged to make 'late run'; 'What could make' signals that.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means the highest point attainable, the ultimate peak of perfection.

clue.text: Brings solace when upset, very ill at ease!

indicators.note: the letters are knocked over into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone sick and uneasy finds comfort when distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease pain or distress is to comfort and relieve a sufferer.

clue.text: Pub brings in satellite after opening — that's born of necessity

indicators.note: the pub word takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: the moon follows the opening

parts.note: a vent is an opening or outlet
Io is one of Jupiter's moons

explanation.surface: A pub installs a satellite dish after opening up, out of sheer need.
explanation.walkthrough: The proverb says necessity is the mother of invention.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb names necessity as the mother of this creation, so it is what necessity gives birth to.

clue.text: Seafaring NCO gets turn to dance as punk

parts.note: PO is a petty officer, a naval non-commissioned officer
a go is a turn, as in 'your go'

explanation.surface: A naval petty officer takes a spin on the dance floor dressed as a punk.
explanation.definitionFit: Punk fans dance by jumping up and down on the spot, named after the spring-loaded stick toy.

clue.text: Present suppliers not entirely marvellous

indicators.note: the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: magic is slang for marvellous

explanation.surface: Gift-givers who were not quite wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: The wise men of the Nativity story brought gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh to the infant Jesus.

clue.text: Men with lowered energy in the East recall trouble

indicators.note: the shifted men word is placed inside the word for the East

parts.note: Asia is the East

indicators.note: in this down clue the energy letter is moved further down the word

parts.note: taken as written
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Men who have flagged in the Orient struggle to remember.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'lowered' moves the E further down: MNE.
explanation.definitionFit: Memory loss is difficulty in calling things to mind.

clue.text: Local artist, lord and clergyman retired

indicators.note: the three pieces are read backwards, as if withdrawing

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician
Lord Lucan, the British peer who vanished in 1974
Rev is short for reverend

explanation.surface: A neighbourhood painter, a peer and a vicar have all retired.
explanation.walkthrough: RALUCANREV read backwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Local speech or architecture native to a region is described as indigenous rather than standard or imported.

clue.text: Genuine fish pigment

parts.note: real means genuine
the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: A real fish colouring.
explanation.definitionFit: This orange-red arsenic sulphide mineral was formerly used as a paint pigment.

clue.text: Attendant always protecting Colonel Lawrence?

indicators.note: the word for always surrounds the colonel

parts.note: ay is an old word for always
T.E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia

explanation.surface: An aide who forever guards Lawrence of Arabia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Colonel Lawrence' looks like one man but splits into two pieces; Lawrence of Arabia signed himself T.E. Lawrence.
explanation.definitionFit: An assistant who serves a priest at the altar is a church attendant.

clue.text: Problem one's presumably unable to sleep on

definitions.text: Problem one's presumably unable to sleep on

parts.words: Problem one's presumably unable to sleep on
parts.note: to sleep on a problem is to put off deciding until morning; with this condition you cannot sleep at all

explanation.surface: A dilemma too pressing to leave until tomorrow.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleeplessness is a disorder that leaves the sufferer awake, so there is no sleeping on anything.

clue.text: Proust reinterpreted produces mental dullness

indicators.note: the letters of the novelist's name are read in a new order

explanation.surface: A new reading of the long French novel leaves the reader dazed.
explanation.definitionFit: A dazed state of near-unconsciousness is a numbing of the mind.

clue.text: Sweetener your drink contains

indicators.note: the drinking word holds the abbreviation

parts.note: to sup is to drink
yr is a written abbreviation for your

explanation.surface: There is sugar in your drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick sugary liquid is used to sweeten food and drinks.

clue.text: Portrait session with painter holding couple in good position

indicators.note: the session-plus-painter string holds the couple letters

parts.note: a sitting is a session posing for a portrait
William Etty, the English painter of nudes
pr is short for pair

explanation.surface: A painter does a portrait sitting holding a pair of figures.
explanation.walkthrough: William Etty was a 19th-century English painter, a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone comfortably placed, well off and at an advantage.

clue.text: Volunteers time to make knotted lace

parts.note: the TA, Territorial Army, was Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: Reservists take time out to do some lacework.
explanation.definitionFit: Tatting is a handicraft of knotting thread with a shuttle to form lace.

clue.text: Hypocritical talk about administrative division

parts.note: cant is insincere pious talk
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Insincere chatter about local government districts.
explanation.definitionFit: Switzerland is divided into states of this kind, also used for subdivisions in France.

clue.text: Electrical device consumer brought to theatre

indicators.note: the consumer is added to the end of the theatre word

parts.note: rep is repertory theatre
an eater consumes

explanation.surface: An electrical gadget a shopper brought along to the playhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'consumer' suggests a shopper; here it is anyone who eats.
explanation.definitionFit: This device receives a signal and retransmits it, boosting it along a line.
